remarks: Come delight in seeing an exceptional New Canaan residence designed with style, sophistication and sited on a stunning landscaped 2.1 acres in a sought after neighborhood. As soon as you arrive, from the double height foyer welcoming you home to the inviting living room and the great family room, this is your place to relax and entertain with family and friends as you gather around the fireplaces.  Come walk the delightful gardens, enjoy the privacy of the mature specimen trees and why not play games across the beautiful lawns. Croquet or soccer anyone? Located on a highly desirable cul-de-sac, the house has a beautiful private spa pool nestled in the gardens. A centrally positioned kitchen with expansive granite counters and island invite you in for conversations and cooking. The handsome paneled library with fireplace and wet bar opens to a spacious terrace, gardens and offers you a retreat for reading, working, and relaxing. Then there is the beautiful first floor Owner's suite as well as a second Primary Suite - take your choice!  All bedrooms are ensuite.  The Lower Level is flexible for relaxation, work, or play in front of the fireplace. To top it off there is the modern convenience of a garage Electric Vehicle Charger Located minutes to the Village with great shops, nationally ranked schools, library, parks, trains. --
